title: Warm Crumbly Ethiopian Green Pepper Flatbread
description: A savory and crumbly Ethiopian flatbread filled with green peppers, perfect for a snack or light meal. This dish is kid-friendly and features a Mediterranean twist.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add warm water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4-6 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a rolled-out dough on the preheated skillet and sprinkle diced green peppers on half of the dough.
Fold the dough in half to enclose the filling and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bottom is golden brown.
Flip the flatbread and cook for another 2 minutes or until the other side is also golden brown.
Shock the flatbread in an ice bath for 30 seconds to stop the cooking process.
Remove the flatbread from the ice bath and brush with olive oil.
